business_summary: S.N.G.N. ROMGAZ S.A. is Romania's state-controlled natural gas producer, listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange (SNG). It is the joint operator, alongside OMV Petrom, of the Neptun Deep offshore gas project, the fixed Black Sea installation near which a marine drone was destroyed and that this whole chain is anchored on.

exposure_summary.narrative: Romgaz's sole offshore-counter-drone placement is offshore-energy-operator (CROWDED, impact 35/crowdedness 74), the same demand-anchor link OMV Petrom sits on: the chain's own role text for this Romgaz placement calls it 'the loser side of this occurrence rather than the opportunity'. Romgaz pays for platform protection and books none of it as revenue; gas price and the 2027 Neptun Deep start date dominate the stock far more than any counter-drone spend, per the chain's own reading.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: counter-drone protection spending is not disclosed as a separate cost line by Romgaz; no revenue percentage applies since this is a cost exposure, not a revenue one, per the chain's own role text. See data_gaps.

latest_fy.basis: Fiscal-year revenue for the period ended 2025-12-31: 8,025,582,000 RON from the yfinance-statements statements in SNG-RO.json.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Compound annual revenue growth computed as (8,025,582,000/13,359,653,000)**(1/3.0007)-1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, period ended 2022-12-31 to period ended 2025-12-31: a revenue decline, consistent with gas prices normalizing down from their 2022 post-invasion spike rather than any operational deterioration.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 4,089,327,000 RON divided by revenue 8,025,582,000 RON, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series: a very high margin typical of upstream gas-producer economics.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 3,588,155,000 RON divided by net income 3,333,105,000 RON, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 3,588,155,000 RON less capex 3,642,418,000 RON, divided by revenue 8,025,582,000 RON, all for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series. Negative: capex now slightly exceeds operating cash flow despite the high accounting operating margin above.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 4,480,329,000 RON (total debt 5,635,539,000 less cash 1,155,210,000, as of 2025-12-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 4,567,209,000 RON (operating income 4,089,327,000 plus depreciation 477,882,000, period ended 2025-12-31), from the yfinance-statements series.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 4 (state MIDDLING) computed over yfinance-statements statements in SNG-RO.json quality.piotroski, 9 of 9 inputs found; failed criteria include change in ROA, accruals, change in leverage, gross margin and asset turnover.

beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score PENDING_DATA in SNG-RO.json quality.beneish: missing sga_fy input (11 of 12 inputs found); not computable this run.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 67,757,257,920 RON computed in SNG-RO.json quality.derived.market_cap from vendor/official share count and price (method section 6A vendor-aggregate fundamentals).

price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 67,757,257,920 RON divided by revenue 8,025,582,000 RON for the period ended 2025-12-31.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Implied FCF CAGR NOT_APPLICABLE in SNG-RO.json quality.reverse_dcf: base-year free cash flow is negative (-54,263,000 RON for 2025-12-31, per quality.derived.fcf), and an implied FCF CAGR solved on a negative base would be meaningless, per the block's own stated reason.

horizon_spread.basis: No horizon_spread computed because the reverse DCF solve is NOT_APPLICABLE (negative base-year free cash flow); see implied_fcf_cagr basis.
